title: PM Demodulator Passband
text: Demodulate PM-modulated data, 1 input, 1 output; {Carrier frequency (Hz)} sets the carrier frequency in Hz, {Initial phase (rad)} sets the initial phase offset in radians, {Phase deviation (rad)} sets the phase deviation of carrier frequency in radians and {Hilbert transform filter order (must be even)}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Carrier frequency (Hz)
params.values: Carrier frequency in Hz 300 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial phase (rad)
params.values: Initial phase offset in radians 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Phase deviation (rad)
params.values: Phase deviation of carrier frequency in radians pi/2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Hilbert transform filter order (must be even)
params.values: Hilbert transform filter order 100 (default) | positive scalar
